# HomeTips

> > Expert home improvement guidance covering repairs, installations, buying advice, and energy efficiency for homeowners.

HomeTips is a trusted resource for DIY home improvement and maintenance advice, authored by Don Vandervort with over 25 years of expertise. The site provides comprehensive guides on home systems, appliances, repairs, and energy-saving strategies to help homeowners make informed decisions.

## Key Topics

- Home Improvement
- DIY Repair & Installation
- Buying Guides
- Energy Efficiency
- HVAC Systems
- Kitchen Appliances
- Water Heaters
- Home Maintenance
- Indoor Air Quality
- How-It-Works Guides
- Appliance Repair
- Heat Pumps
- Home Systems
- Product Comparison
- Cost-Saving Strategies

## Core Resources

- [Home Improvement Ideas & Answers You Can Trust](https://www.hometips.com): HomeTips homepage with expert advice by Don Vandervort and HGTV.
- [How Your House Works](https://www.hometips.com/how-it-works): Diagramed guide to home systems and appliances by Don Vandervort.
- [Browse](https://www.hometips.com/browse): Browse HomeTips subject categories for home improvement content.
- [About HomeTips](https://www.hometips.com/about-us): HomeTips team background and 25+ year history of home improvement.

## Repair & Maintenance Guides

- [How to Repair](https://www.hometips.com/repair-fix): DIY repair guides for toilets, sinks, water heaters, and HVAC systems.
- [How to Install or Build](https://www.hometips.com/diy-how-to): Installation and building guides for home improvement projects.
- [Save Energy](https://www.hometips.com/save-energy): Expert advice on energy efficiency, insulation, audits, and cost-saving strategies.

## Appliance Buying & Selection Guides

- [Buying Guides](https://www.hometips.com/buying-guides): Expert buying guides for home products, appliances, HVAC, and doors.
- [How to Select a Range, Oven or Cooktop](https://www.hometips.com/buying-guides/cooking-ranges.html): Range and cooktop selection guide with types and features.
- [Dishwashers](https://www.hometips.com/kitchen_dishwashers.html): Dishwasher buying, installation, troubleshooting, and repair guide.
- [Refrigerators & Freezers](https://www.hometips.com/kitchen_refrigerators.html): Refrigerator and freezer buying, repair, and how-it-works guide.
- [Clothes Dryers](https://www.hometips.com/clothes_dryers.html): Clothes dryer buying, installation, repair, and how-it-works guide.

## Climate Control & Air Quality

- [Best Air Purifier & Cleaner Buying Guide](https://www.hometips.com/buying-guides/air-cleaners-filters-purifiers.html): Air purifier buying guide with EPA guidance on indoor air quality.
- [Buying the Best Window Air Conditioner or Room AC Unit](https://www.hometips.com/buying-guides/air-conditioners-room.html): Window AC unit buying guide with sizing and feature advice.
- [Home Humidifiers Buying Guide](https://www.hometips.com/buying-guides/home-humidifiers.html): Humidifier buying guide for whole-house and portable models.
- [Dehumidifiers Buying Guide](https://www.hometips.com/buying-guides/dehumidifiers.html): Dehumidifier buying guide for humidity control and air quality.

## Kitchen & Utility Systems

- [Appliances](https://www.hometips.com/appliances): Guide to home appliances including buying, repair, and installation.
- [Garbage Disposal Buying Guide](https://www.hometips.com/buying-guides/garbage-disposals.html): Garbage disposal buying guide with grinding power and type advice.
- [Central Vacuum Systems Overview](https://www.hometips.com/central_vacuum_systems.html): Central vacuum system overview covering operation and purchasing.
